name: browserdrive
title: Browser drive
blurb: Playwright-style browser automation with no browser on the server. An agent or a script sends steps (go to a page, click, type, press, drag, wait for, read text, run JavaScript, screenshot); a person's open runner page claims the session and plays each step in a frame of this site, and the result comes back. For checking pages and flows an agent built, against sandbox pages only.
